ambiguities.aspect: signed vs unsigned interpretation of A and B
readings: Treat A and B as unsigned 3-bit values (000=0 .. 111=7); e.g. A=111, B=001 => A_greater=1
Treat A and B as two's-complement signed 3-bit values (100=-4 .. 011=3); e.g. A=111, B=001 => A_less=1
Outputs are purely combinational and reflect A/B in the same cycle
Outputs are registered (e.g. on a clock) and appear one cycle after A/B change; the spec names no clock, so this reading is unlikely but not excluded
X/Z on any input propagates X to all three outputs (standard continuous-assignment semantics)
Undefined/never-occurring inputs may be optimised (e.g. don't-care) and outputs may resolve to 0 for those bits

ambiguities.aspect: bit significance ordering of the vector indices
readings: A[2] and B[2] are the MSBs (standard descending-range convention)
Index ordering is unspecified; an implementer could treat A[0]/B[0] as the MSB
